note: Sync function: on insert, fill whichever of amount/total is missing from the other; on update, copy the changed one to the other.

Add nullable total (metadata-only, no rewrite) and the sync trigger in one transaction, so no row is ever inserted without total. Short lock_timeout with retries so app queries never queue behind the ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock.

Backfill procedure: copies amount to total in 50,000-row id ranges, committing after each batch (short row locks, no long transaction). Every row above the max id it sees was inserted with the trigger in place.
Run the backfill (on its own so the procedure can COMMIT between batches).
Clean up the dead tuples from the backfill (plain VACUUM does not block reads or writes).
NOT NULL without a long lock, part 1: add CHECK (total IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID (instant, retried on lock timeout).
Part 2: validate the check. Full scan under SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE, so reads and writes keep going. Fails (and stops the plan, in a safe state) if any row still lacks total.
Part 3: SET NOT NULL uses the validated check and skips the scan; then drop the now-redundant check. Retried on lock timeout.
Switch the app to total. During the rolling update, old pods write amount and new pods write total; the trigger fills in the other column either way, and every row already has both.
